additionalDocuments.label: REMAPP-hosted SAMANA Downtown One · floor-plan pack

review.imagery: Sixteen developer-published project renders were visually reviewed. Six current gallery images cover the tower, frontage, rooftop and interiors. Ten native brochure images add living, bathroom, lobby and proposed amenities. Blue backgrounds and repeated scenes are excluded. The day tower view supplies the card and hero, with no card badges. Futuristic amenity scenes remain proposed concepts, with final equipment and specifications unverified.
review.floorPlans: Ten residence layouts and nine floorplates retain their complete source pages. No numerical apartment areas are printed on these drawings. Confirm the selected unit’s contractual area and final specification with SAMANA. All ten primary brochure residence pages 31–40 were individually reviewed, including their complete position keys and notices. The REMAPP-hosted branded pack adds nine floorplates and amenity layouts on physical pages 1–9. Its duplicate residence drawings are excluded. All floorplate headings and building scope were checked. No inferred unit dimensions, portal size ranges or amenity numbering are represented as apartment areas.
review.location: The complete original brochure page 9 was visually reviewed. The primary page’s exact q coordinate 24.970368, 55.088992 is retained in a source-hashed map receipt, scoped as vicinity. Ten published travel ranges retain unspecified mode and route. The airport is sourced to the current page, separately from the brochure legend.
review.provenance: Fresh primary HTML, original brochure and broker-hosted branded plan/fact PDFs retain retrieval receipts, original bytes and SHA-256 values. Native gallery URLs, original PDF physical-page links and complete drawing notices are preserved. Protected identity and completed commercial/text research are unchanged.

unavailable: Numerical unit-area schedules, a verified visitor entrance and dated construction photographs were not established. Amenity imagery shows proposed concepts. Final unit specification, size and equipment require developer confirmation.
